description: In local stdio MCP only, export articles as deployment-ready files for Astro, Next.js, Jekyll, Hugo, or git codebases. Remote HTTP MCP cannot write to the caller filesystem and returns a clear remote_filesystem_unavailable error instead of a server-local path.

out_dir.description: Directory to write into (created if missing; relative paths resolve against the MCP server cwd)

project_id.description: MotiBlog project id permitted by the current credential. Omit when a default project is configured.

status.description: Which lifecycle stage to export (default PUBLISHED)

name: export_blog
title: Export Blog to Files
